::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 12th  1885  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell
:::

My dear [Miss Soulsby](people/person_1351.qmd),

The worst of it is that I am afraid all the writers of the ‘rejected addresses’ want to be paid and I do not suppose the resources of the [All Saints Magazine](organizations/other_254.qmd) would warrant that hope.[^1]  I am sorry I have sent home most of the competition stories for the Christmas number

yours truly
C M Yonge

I have just found <u>one</u>.  If it will do, write and ask permission of the 

[the rest missing]

---

[^1]: Lucy Soulsby was teaching at Cheltenham Ladies’ College;  she seems to have been soliciting contributions for the parish magazine.
